hypothesis: The two possible cyclic ring coverings are misread as two globally synchronized patterns across all four identically oriented red/blue hole corners, rather than independent choices at four rings.
substantive_difference: Earlier background08 retained no design: proposed domino partitions risked fixed coverings. This uses only open incident sides of the four original black holes, maps a local orientation frame across independent components, and draws zero candidate domino boundaries or white-cell partitions. No earlier frozen candidate exists to reuse.
